thread:
Maya (VP Eng): Thanks for the great turnout. Capturing the key runtime Q&A follow-ups here so we have a single thread for owners.
Ethan (Director, Runtime): Kernel rollout cadence: small incremental canaries weekly, broader rollouts monthly. First canary for `kernel-r` next Tue; initial traffic 0.75% for 40m.
Console-bot: Canary scheduled: id=canary-218888, start=2026-05-20T14:00:00Z, traffic=0.75%.
Fiona (ML Research): Request: publish per-model perf SLO table (seq buckets). PMs need concrete numbers for customer SLAs.
Maya (VP Eng): Agreed. New published SLOs: tiny (<=512): p95<=60ms, short (512-2k): p95<=120ms, mid (2k-8k): p95<=280ms, long (8k+): p95<=650ms. These will appear in the SLA appendix.
Cody (Infra): Ops note: kernel-r uses a new CUDA alloc path; we'll schedule node drains 20m before canary and monitor mem-alloc metrics.
Rae (SRE): Observability asks: add `kernel_tag`, `batch_size_hist`, `cache_hit_rate`, `kernel_variant` to per-route traces/dashboards. Pager if p95 > SLA for 3 consecutive 1m windows.
Ethan (Director, Runtime): Batching defaults: moving dynamic batch token cap from 8->14 for most gen models. Model config flags: `max_batch_tokens`, `batch_timeout_ms`. We'll add a `long_context` profile with lower defaults.
Fiona (ML Research): How do these changes impact cold long-context tails?
Ethan (Director, Runtime): Cold long-contexts will be routed to an isolation lane with `max_batch_tokens=3` and higher scheduling priority to reduce tail latency. Cache-aware routing will prefer cache-hit traffic for high-batch lanes. Default TTLs: prefix=10m, session=45m.
Maya (VP Eng): Quantization guidance: action item Fiona+Ethan to draft a short "quantization playbook" with measured p50/p95 and quality notes for 4-bit vs 8-bit (incl. sample prompts). Due Wed EOD.
Rae (SRE): Canary rollback criteria proposal: auto-rollback if p95 increases >6% vs baseline OR error-rate delta >3% OR any new OOM. Also require smoke-suite pass before traffic expansion.
Ethan (Director, Runtime): We'll implement a lightweight smoke: perf run + 120 short prompts + 40 long prompts + memory checks. Smoke fail = no expansion.
Cody (Infra): Console: can we show a small banner during canaries? "Runtime canary in progress — small % of traffic".
Console-bot: UI ticket created: ui-6210, assignee=Console Team.
Maya (VP Eng): Owners summary: (1) Fiona+Ethan: quant playbook (Wed EOD), (2) Ethan: batching defaults PR + model profiles (next week), (3) Rae: codify rollback rules + alerting playbook (PR by Mon), (4) Console: canary banner (ui-6210). I'll follow up with calendar invites.
Ethan (Director, Runtime): I'll post PR links here when ready.
Fiona (ML Research): Starting perf runs now; will drop a short table of p50/p95 in this thread.
Maya (VP Eng): Thanks all — keep updates here. Closing thread for now and will re-open as action items move. :white_check_mark:
